title: phyllanthus lathyroides var. genuinus
intro: Phyllanthus lathyroides var. genuinus, commonly known as Sandao Jia, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Phyllanthus lathyroides var. genuinus include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
